understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for the level and game to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one 3-pixel grid cell per directional action. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed along with a piece, while walls and boundaries could block movement in ways indicated only heuristically by the blocked hints. Multiple selectable pieces could be controlled by CLICKing their exact pixel/grid coordinates; movement then applied to the selected piece. Efficient coordination of pieces and pushed objects was necessary within each level's finite step budget.
